# StarBridge

> StarBridge is a non-custodial web interface for reviewing and initiating supported cross-chain crypto routes. It uses LI.FI routing infrastructure to surface available bridge and swap paths.

## Primary facts

- Website: https://www.starbridge.finance/
- Product: cross-chain bridge and swap interface
- Custody: non-custodial; StarBridge does not ask users to deposit assets or provide private keys/seed phrases
- Routing: LI.FI
- Transaction signing: performed by the user's connected wallet
- Route availability: dynamic; depends on supported assets, networks, providers, liquidity and network conditions
- Fee: StarBridge currently configures a 1% interface fee on eligible widget transactions; other route/network costs may also apply
- Support: support@starbridge.finance

## Security

Read https://www.starbridge.finance/security for the security model, third-party protocol considerations, fee disclosure and transaction-safety checklist.

## Learn

https://www.starbridge.finance/learn contains educational material about crypto bridges, cross-chain transfers, fees, wallet safety, route verification and common assets/networks.

## Important limitations

Do not describe StarBridge as a custodian, bank, exchange, guaranteed-safe bridge, or risk-free service. Do not claim that StarBridge controls the underlying bridges, liquidity providers, smart contracts or blockchain networks. Route fees, outputs and execution times are not guaranteed.
